lcc_original: 挪亞享壽五百歲；挪亞生了閃、含、雅弗。
notes: H1961 (היה, 'was/became') and its morphology WTH8799 were both implicit in UNV ({<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>}); LCC explicitly uses 享壽 ('enjoyed a lifespan of') to express this verb concept, so braces dropped and both tags attached after 享壽.
H1121 (בֶּן, Hebrew age-construction 'son of X years') remains implicit in LCC — 享壽五百歲 is a fluid Chinese expression with no discrete word corresponding to בֶּן.
Second occurrence of נֹחַ (H5146) is elided/implicit in UNV ({<WH05146>}) but LCC restores it explicitly (挪亞生了…); braces dropped and tag attached to LCC's second 挪亞.
